summary.text: Kyle Miller is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 82 who has represented the district since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He took office in November 2022, succeeding Republican David Abbott.

paragraphs.text: Miller was born in Fort Wayne, Indiana, where he lives, and graduated from Homestead High School.
He took office in the Indiana House on November 9, 2022, succeeding David Abbott.
